summary: First test iteration for NEXORIA. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests pass (auth, game data, posts/feed, reactions/comments, quests, skills, inventory, kingdom, leaderboards, chronicle, badges, rifts, boss, Oracle Claude Sonnet 4.5 — verified non-empty French RPG response, admin). Frontend: Landing page, login flow with admin, sidebar nav, feed posting (+20 XP toast), Oracle chat (real Claude response in French), and Admin dashboard all working. Logout, posts grant XP/badges (first_step, creator after 10 posts) verified.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD — clients must use real-looking domains. Not a bug, just noted.

Backend FastAPI CORS allows only FRONTEND_URL env var ('https://4d13afb6-...preview') which mismatches actual frontend domain ('nexoria-hero.preview'). Currently works because Kubernetes ingress overrides CORS headers to ACAO:* + credentials:true, but that combo is technically invalid per CORS spec — browser may reject in stricter environments. Recommend updating FRONTEND_URL or using a list.

ui_bugs.issue: Email/Username/Password inputs lack data-testid (only 'register-next-btn' present). Functional but harder to automate.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid to register step-1 inputs (register-email, register-username, register-password) for testability — login page already has them.

(Optional) Update backend FRONTEND_URL in /app/backend/.env to match the actual frontend domain ('https://nexoria-hero.preview.emergentagent.com') so FastAPI CORS matches; currently ingress masks the issue but stricter browsers may break credentialed CORS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 972 lines — should be split into routers (auth, game, social, oracle, admin) for maintainability.
CORS middleware uses single FRONTEND_URL string; should be a list and include both preview origins.
Skills/quests/inventory endpoints look correct; all use user_id pattern (no Mongo _id leakage) and exclude password_hash properly in admin/leaderboard responses.
Oracle integration via emergentintegrations + Claude Sonnet 4.5 works end-to-end (verified real ~600 char French RPG response).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@nexoria.com / NexoriaAdmin2026! (verified working). Fresh users created via /api/auth/register with class_id in [mage, warrior, assassin, paladin, alchemist, explorer, necromancer, architect, chronomancer, inventor].
seed_data_creation: Tests create users prefixed TEST_<hex>@nexoria-test.com. Several test posts (TEST grind 0..11, UI test post from admin) and one TEST_<>react/comment chain inserted. Not cleaned up — admin can delete via /api/admin/users/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_nexoria_api.py covers all major endpoints. To rerun: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_nexoria_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend data-testid map: login-{email,password}-input, login-submit-btn, register-next-btn, register-submit-btn, class-{class_id}, post-composer-input, post-submit-btn, oracle-input, oracle-send-btn, nav-{feed,hero,skills,kingdom,inventory,quests,oracle,leaderboards,legends,admin}. Register step-1 username/email/password inputs do NOT yet have data-testids. EmailStr rejects .test TLD — use nexoria-test.com or similar.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues found. Initial test failures were caused by test-side issues (invalid .test TLD, wrong class IDs 'guerrier'/'voyageur' vs actual 'warrior'/'explorer', and server-side email lowercasing) — all fixed in test file. App is functioning correctly.
